message.content:
I don’t have real‑time access to weather data, so I can’t give you the current conditions in San Francisco right now. However, here’s a quick overview of what you can generally expect:

| Season | Typical Temperature | Weather Patterns |
|--------|---------------------|------------------|
| Winter (Dec–Feb) | 48–58 °F (9–14 °C) | Cool, often foggy, especially near the coast. |
| Spring (Mar–May) | 55–68 °F (13–20 °C) | Mild, gradually warming; occasional rain. |
| Summer (Jun–Aug) | 60–75 °F (16–24 °C) | Warm, dry, but coastal fog can keep temperatures comfortable. |
| Fall (Sep–Nov) | 58–70 °F (14–21 °C) | Pleasant, with decreasing rainfall toward November. |

If you need the current forecast, you can check a reliable weather site or app such as:

- **Weather.com** (The Weather Channel)
- **AccuWeather**
- **National Weather Service** (weather.gov)
- **Weather Underground** (wunderground.com)

Just type “San Francisco weather” into your search engine or open one of those apps, and you’ll get the latest temperature, precipitation chances, wind speed, and any alerts.
